_comment: Sound Alias JSON Structure for Gungame Killstreak Audio - Generated by build-streak-sounds.ps1

_field_guide.aliasName: Sound alias name - referenced in code as playLocalSound('gg_streak_<name>')
_field_guide.count: Number of sound variations (always 1 for killstreaks)
_field_guide.volMin: Minimum playback volume (0.0-1.0, can randomize between min and max)
_field_guide.distMin: Closest distance before attenuation applies (game units)
_field_guide.distMax: Farthest distance sound is audible (game units)
_field_guide.volumeFalloffCurve: Type of volume fade curve (weapon_grenadebounce is standard for UI)
_field_guide.flags: Behavior flags (1664 = standard UI sound flags)

_common_tweaks.make_louder: Increase volMin from 0.64 to 0.75, volMax from 0.72 to 0.85
_common_tweaks.make_quieter: Decrease volMin from 0.64 to 0.50, volMax from 0.72 to 0.60
_common_tweaks.make_pitched_up: Increase pitchMin from 0.90 to 0.95, pitchMax from 0.95 to 1.05
_common_tweaks.make_pitched_down: Decrease pitchMin from 0.90 to 0.80, pitchMax from 0.95 to 0.90

_notes.generation: JSON aliases are auto-generated by build-streak-sounds.ps1 PowerShell script
_notes.integration: Compiled into mod.ff via zonebuilder 'buildzone mod' command
_notes.validation: All fields must be present for sound to load correctly
_notes.reference: See SOUNDREF.md and SOUND_QUICK_REF.txt for audio mastering specs
